annotatedSteps.description: Calculation of voltage drop across 3 Ω resistor
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Correct method and computation using carried-forward current value (ECF applied).

teacherNote: Marked against: Calculation of total series resistance: R = R1 + R2 + R3 = 10 Ω (1); Calculation of total current: I = V / R = 15 / 10 = 1.5 A (1); Calculation of voltage drop across 3 Ω resistor: V = I * R = 1.5 * 3 = 4.5 V (1). Clear working and correct application of Ohm's law throughout. Take extra care when copying given values from the question paper, as the voltage was 15 V rather than 18 V. Full marks are awarded for part (C) under the error carried forward rule.
